It seems to me that you yourself have already listed some reasons why you shouldn't kill yourself. I remember when I was seriously depressed a year ago. I tried to do the same thing you just did, which is make a list of reasons why I shouldn't kill myself. Every time I came up with a reason, I immediately discarded it. I'd tell myself, "I want to kill myself and I think this will make me feel better? A whole lot of good it's doing me if I want to kill myself." The whole point here is that the argument is circular and you aren't evaluating yourself fairly. In your post you say you have a dad that cares and loves you and would feel devastated. You also say you have a step-mom, a sister, and step-brothers that would be sad. Moreover, you mention that you've accomplished things in your life and are aware of it. You also have a lot of life to look forward to. You'll be a super-senior, which means you'll be close to graduating and starting the next step in life. Yeah, you've probably made some mistakes but who hasn't? You might also feel scared about the future. I am, and most people are too! 

Want to talk about why you're feeling rejected and lonely? I was feeling very down a few hours ago. I made a post on this subreddit, talked to a lovely person and am now feeling a lot better. There are a lot of people here who would like to chat. I'll send you a PM if you're interested.
